title: AI as Coordination-Compressing Capital: Task Reallocation, Organizational Redesign, and the Regime Fork
abstract: arXiv:2602.16078v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Task-based models of AI hold organizational structure fixed. We model AI as agent capital that compresses managers' per-link coordination costs toward residual floors for consequential decisions. Positive floors bound spans of control; zero floors do not. For a fixed manager pool, proportional team sizes, equal mean team quality and fixed within-firm pay shares, and when every floor is positive, the floors determine long-run managerial wage dispersion, independent of execution-compression parameters. With a common positive floor, distinct skills and skill-biased execution savings, managerial inequality is purely transitional: zero at zero capital and in the long run, positive at every positive finite capital level. If every lower-floor manager approaches capacity faster than every higher-floor one, inequality exceeds its long-run level at sufficiently large finite capital and converges from above, a non-monotone path. Numerical illus

translated_title: AI作为协调压缩型资本：任务再分配、组织再设计与机制分岔
translated_abstract: 基于任务的AI模型将组织结构视为固定不变。我们将AI建模为一种“代理资本”，对于重大决策，它能把管理者每条协调链接的成本压缩至某个剩余下限。正的下限会约束管理跨度，而零下限则不会。在管理者池固定、团队规模成比例、平均团队质量相等、企业内部薪酬份额固定，且所有下限均为正的条件下，这些下限决定了长期的管理者工资离散度，而与执行压缩参数无关。在共同正下限、技能各异且执行节约偏向技能的设定下，管理者不平等纯粹是过渡性的：在零资本时和长期中为零，但在每一个正的有限资本水平上均为正。如果每个下限较低的管理者都比下限较高的管理者更快地逼近其容量上限，则在足够大的有限资本下，不平等会超过其长期水平并从上方收敛，呈现出一条非单调路径。数值示例……[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 该研究将AI建模为压缩管理者协调成本的代理资本，证明当协调成本下限为正时，长期管理者工资差距由下限而非AI执行压缩参数决定，因此AI引发的管理者不平等只是过渡现象，并可能沿非单调路径先升后降再收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper models AI as agent capital that compresses managers' per-link coordination costs, proving that with positive coordination floors, long-run managerial wage dispersion is determined by the floors rather than execution-compression parameters—making AI-driven managerial inequality purely transitional and potentially following a non-monotone path before converging from above.
